scope: Extend the qualified fixed-geometry resolved_repair@1 synthetic controls from 50 us to 2 ms, with unchanged injury/closure/ion parameters. Qualify all 39 state fields, conservation, long replay and a reusable sampled-return observer. Measure return of patch voltage and owned free cytosol/exterior concentrations to the matching independent uninjured trajectory. Every outcome, including incomplete recovery, is retained. These engineering bands are not measured physiological targets or a biological recovery claim.

recovery_observer.scope: Maximum absolute difference over every physical owner for each metric, simultaneous final hold on registered samples only. Disturbance must first be resolved beyond the band and uncertainty; no interpolation or assumption between observations. Baseline drift is reported, not interpreted as healthy rest. Reference agreement and original conservation checks must pass independently of recovery outcome.

checks: Host readout adversarial controls: no disturbance, sustained sampled return, late excursions, brief reentry, near-band uncertainty, mismatched modalities, baseline drift, release before hold, missing samples and malformed inputs. These are numerical/engineering controls, not biological cases.

Every 83-time observation grid is accepted exactly at all three timesteps. Both off-grid injury boundaries remain explicit. Fixed 16384-step allowance covers the finest grid without changing physical limits. The finest trace and two-world aggregate working declarations are 8 GiB; preflight must reject the old 4-GiB budgets. These conservative array estimates are distinct from the unchanged 14-GiB measured process-tree ceiling and 4-GiB host reserve.

Four complete compiled 2-ms histories, actual device placement, all 39 state fields and ordinary observations, preserved before assertions. Analytic damage and original material/charge/energy/domain checks remain mandatory.

Independent segmented DOP853, Decimal/scalar transport and full-node electrical roots. Held and resealing references are checked after fourfold tightening. Complete state and independent voltages/free concentrations are retained, including failed comparisons. CPU references are reused by GPU only after exact input/settings/status checks.

Sampled recovery is evaluated against the independent uninjured trajectory; labels must match independently integrated injury trajectories. Ordinary uninjured/sham histories and all pre-injury histories are exact. Held and resealing disturbance must be resolved. A diminishing damage fraction does not force a recovery label; every arm and per-metric outcome remains visible.

Held and resealing coupled trajectories refine at 0.625/0.3125/0.15625 us with original absolute/relative state budgets and roundoff floors. Complete inputs, histories and signed errors are saved before assertions.

Complete 1-ms disk checkpoint restart and changed 257-step windows match bitwise. Two independent 2-ms worlds with distinct closure controls match scalar histories under batching and reversed world order.

Complete CPU/L4 histories and readouts use unchanged unit-specific tolerances; times/external controls are exact. Recovery labels must agree. The earlier 50-us fresh-process and assembly qualification remains a prerequisite, not new long-duration assembly evidence.
Serial bounded process groups; all source/runtime/evidence checks and CPU/GPU counters are retained. No automatic follow-up or retries.
scope_exclusions: No parameter fitting or selection for a positive recovery result; synthetic rates and short physical horizon, not measured tissue times.
No autonomous adaptation, structural repair material/energy, topology change, cutting, regrowth or experimental biological claim. Channel-compensation research stays parked.
Return is relative to a matched evolving uninjured trajectory. Absolute healthy resting ranges and continuous-time functional recovery are not established.
Longer ordinary tissue execution only. Assembly remains qualified in the preceding 50-us panel; it is not included in this 2-ms extension.

Independent-world execution on local CPU/L4; multi-GPU execution and single-tissue distribution remain separate. Whole-phase utilization includes host references and compilation and is not a warmed throughput gate.

prerequisite.scope: Passed 50-us CPU/L4 injury, replay and assembly qualification
